title: Coriqo third-party validator manifest, format version 1
description: How a validator written outside Coriqo describes itself. This document is a claim by its author, not a verified fact: nothing here is checked against the code except by the conformance suite the author is expected to run and a reviewer is expected to re-run. Version 1 carries no signature field on purpose — see the spec's 'Left out of version 1' section.

validator_id.description: The id this validator writes into every result it produces. Must not collide with a validator id Coriqo ships.

version.description: Semantic version of this validator's logic, independent of any protocol it runs under.

author.description: Who wrote it. Carried through to the assurance package so a bank reading a result can see it did not come from Coriqo.

entry_point.description: Import path of the Validator subclass, as `module.path:ClassName`.

controls.description: Control ids the author claims this validator exercises. A claim, not an assertion Coriqo makes: whether the evidence supports the control is decided by the control's own pass logic on the server, not by this list.
